en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from Musa Bin Ibrahim Al Muharby, from Al Hassan Bin Musa, from Musa Bin Abdullah, from Maymoun Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘The one who is full of himself indicate upon the weakness of his own intellect’.
